vendors.name: Cursor
vendors.billing: credit pool + usage multiplier; Auto mode unlimited (no credit burn)
vendors.notes: Bugbot add-on $20 (Pro) / $40 (Teams). Non-Auto agent requests add $0.25/MTok. Official guidance: daily agent users ~$60-100/mo, power users $200+. Composer 2.5 + Mission Control UI preview shown late Jul 2026. TEAMS DUAL-POOL (Jun 2026 restructure, effective for renewing customers after 2026-07-01): each seat splits into a first-party pool (Composer 2.5 + Auto) and a separate third-party API pool (manually selected Claude/GPT-5 etc.); when the third-party pool is exhausted Cursor FALLS BACK to Composer/Auto instead of cutting access - key difference vs Copilot hard overage billing.

vendors.name: Claude Code
vendors.billing: via Claude subscription or API per token (no standalone sub)
deadlines: 2026-08-17 legacy Workbench + 3 experimental prompt-tool APIs retire
vendors.notes: 5h rolling window + weekly cap; Max tiers have an extra model-specific weekly cap. Quota shared across chat/Code/Cowork, no rollover. Rule of thumb: above ~$7/day API spend, Max subscription is cheaper. Cache reads ~1/10 of input price. Sonnet 5 is default model (native 1M ctx, SWE-Bench 82.1%). Opus 5 released 2026-07-24. SONNET 5 MIGRATION TWO PITFALLS: (1) temperature/top_p params now ERROR - must remove before switching model ID; (2) new tokenizer emits ~1/3 more tokens for same text vs Sonnet 4.6, so all prior token/cost budgets are systematically under-estimated. Opus 4.1 (claude-opus-4-1-20250805) retired 2026-08-05 - grep repos AND Bedrock/Vertex for old IDs.

vendors.name: GitHub Copilot
vendors.billing: GitHub AI Credits (1 credit = $0.01), token-metered since 2026-06-01
vendors.notes: First full cycle closed 2026-06-30: heavy agentic seats saw 10x-50x bill surge ($600-3000/mo). Completions & Next Edit unlimited/free. Model menu spread ~60x. MAI-Code-1-Flash ($0.75/$4.50) cheapest, GA for Business/Enterprise. Grok 4.5 added 2026-07-28. Credits do not roll over. Cloud agent also consumes Actions minutes. Agent Skills went preview -> GA within a month. PROMO CREDITS END 2026-08-31: Business/Enterprise revert to $19/$39 base starting Sep 1 - bill jump risk. Code review now DOUBLE-METERED (AI Credits + Actions minutes). User-level budget controls GA.

plans.included: per 5h window: Sol 10-100 / Terra 25-200 / Luna 250-2000 messages

vendors.notes: WAU >5M. Local + cloud tasks share one credit pool. After the 2026-07-31 price cut, Terra/Luna consume FEWER credits inside subscriptions while sub prices/quotas stay unchanged. WARNING (科创板日报 2026-08-04): devs report GPT-5.6 now CHARGES for cache-creation that was FREE on 5.5 - 'real cost may feel 2x higher' despite Luna -80% list cut. Always verify cache billing rule changes, not just list price.

vendors.name: Zhipu GLM Coding Plan
vendors.billing: CREDIT-BASED (CN) vs PROMPT-COUNT (Intl) - two systems now diverged

plans.note: existing users only; V1 users can buy until expiry, entry ~mid-Aug

vendors.intl_prompt_multipliers: GLM-5.2/GLM-5-Turbo: peak 3x / off-peak 2x (non-peak 1x promo until end of Sep). 1 prompt may trigger 15-20 model calls.
vendors.peak_hours: Mon-Fri 14:00-18:00 UTC+8 at 1x; ALL other times incl. full weekends at 0.5x
vendors.notes: Tier ratios changed: Pro=6x Lite, Max=14x Lite (was 5x/20x). Legacy V1/V2 and team plans keep original pricing & rules. Models: GLM-5.2 / GLM-5-Turbo / GLM-4.7 (GLM-5.1/GLM-5 auto-route to 5.2). 20+ tools; OpenClaw runs at secondary scheduling priority. Official claim: up to 92% cheaper than pay-as-you-go GLM-5.2 API when using off-peak. HighSpeed tier available by application. ZCode 3.0 ADE uses in-house agent kernel, GLM-5.2 gets 1.5x quota inside ZCode. CN uses CREDIT metering; Intl Z.ai retains PROMPT-COUNT (two systems now fully diverged).

vendors.name: Baidu Qianfan Token Plan (Personal)
vendors.billing: unified token quota across models (no model multiplier, no input/output/cache distinction)
vendors.notes: Coding Plan all tiers stopped selling 2026-07-13; Token Plan Personal fully open. THREE-LAYER throttling system fully removed - no peak-hour slowdown. Models: ERNIE-5.1, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Tools: Cursor, Windsurf, Cline (10+), OpenAI + Anthropic protocol compatible. Dedicated personal API key isolated from postpaid/enterprise. Promo = daily 10:00 limited flash sale. Separate credit-based 'Token Welfare Pack': 50/100/200/400/800 CNY tiers.

vendors.name: Alibaba Qoder CN
vendors.billing: unified Credits since 2026-05-20; monthly seat subscription; Credits shared across QoderWork CN / Qoder CLI CN / Qoder CN IDE

plans.included: 300 initial Credits + 14-day Pro trial; capped completions/chats

vendors.notes: The ONLY mainstream 'IDE bundle + unified credits' player in CN (previously missed in earlier reports; added 2026-08-05). Monthly Credits expire (no rollover); burn order: free -> subscription -> addon pack -> pay-as-you-go. Upgrade Pro->Pro+ is irreversible (old plan voids, remaining credits become one-time addon pack). Sign-up/pay on qoder.com.cn (Alipay), phone linked to Alibaba Cloud. Use case: all-domestic models, CN cloud deploy, data stays in-country - fits finance/government compliance. Real-world: devs say '169 CNY Pro+ is basically enough for one person per month'. Supports Cloud Agents + QoderWake persistent duty.

vendors.name: Volcano Ark Coding Plan / Agent Plan

plans.promo_note: first 2 months at 25%; package promo window 2026-06-08 to 2026-08-08 (some 3rd-party sources claim 08-27 - verify in console)

plans.included: 5x Lite + Auto model routing + priority scheduling

vendors.notes: TWO SEPARATE PROMOS (previously conflated): (1) PACKAGE first-2-months 25% off - official 618 window 2026-06-08 to 2026-08-08 (some 3rd-party sources say extended to 08-27; trust console). (2) GLM-5.2 DEDUCTION 25% off - official docs 2026-06-10 18:00 to 2026-08-08 23:59 (this is model billing discount, NOT package price cut). Rules: deadline = order/renew/upgrade cutoff, not benefit duration; max 2 promo months/account; eligibility shared across new/renew/upgrade. MODEL REFRESH (Aug): added Kimi-K2.7-Code, MiniMax-M3 (512K), DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Doubao-Seed-2.1-turbo. RETIRING: Doubao-Seed-2.0-Code, Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro, Doubao-Seed-Code. 1M ctx: glm-5.2, deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro. Quota refresh: 5h rolls from first request time; weekly resets Mon 00:00; monthly resets on sub-month day 1. RED LINE: quota only valid inside AI coding tools - using its Base URL/API key in non-coding tools may be flagged abuse -> subscription suspended or account banned. Separate Agent Plan supports multimodal (AFP fine-grained deduction); console gives 25M free Tokens.

Models: mimo-v2.5-pro, mimo-v2.5, mimo-v2-omni, mimo-v2-flash, ASR, TTS (TTS free for limited time). Tools: Claude Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, KiloCode, Roo Code, Cline, Codex, Cherry Studio, Zed, TRAE, CodeBuddy. OpenAI + Anthropic API compatible. Real-name required, no refunds.

trends: THREE-WAY price split in one week: OpenAI cut (Luna -80%), DeepSeek pushed lower (V4-Flash out $0.28), Zhipu raised (Pro +261%). Vendors pick strategy by compute cost & ecosystem position - not a single 'up/down' trend

DeepSeek redefines the cost floor: 1 point behind on AA index (50 vs 51), 60% cheaper - destabilizes all mid-position models; most direct hit on CN coding/agent/long-ctx models esp GLM-5.2 (Zhipu stock -20% that week)
WARNING nominal-cut/actual-rise: devs report OpenAI now charges cache-creation that was free; 'cost may feel 2x higher'. Always check cache billing rule changes, not just list price

Billing paradigm migration complete: request-count -> token/credit/points across Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Zhipu CN, Baidu/Alibaba/Tencent/Xiaomi/Qoder; Tokenomics Foundation formed. Only exception: Z.ai intl still prompt-count

TIME-OF-DAY pricing is the overlooked lever: Zhipu CN off-peak 0.5x (incl all weekends), Z.ai non-peak 1x (until end Sep), Xiaomi night 0.8x, Alibaba night 0.2x - shifting heavy work off-peak = free 20-80% discount
Subscription price is a floor: Copilot heavy users paid 10-50x list; Copilot promo credits end Sep 1 -> Business/Enterprise bills jump; code review now double-metered
Model routing = cost lever: cheap models (V4-Flash/Luna/Haiku/GLM-4.7/MAI-Code-1-Flash) save multiples; Volcano flags high deduction coeff for MiniMax-M2.7/Kimi-K2.6/V4-Pro
DEDICATED coding models replace frontier generalists: Kimi K2.7 Code ($4 out) not K3 ($15); MS MAI-Code-1-Flash; Kuaishou KAT-Coder-Pro. 'Frontier model for coding' becomes a luxury
Migration cost is the soft spot: AI coding lacks social-network lock-in, user switching cost is low -> low price won't convert to long-term lock-in; users need not over-loyal to any vendor
